Samir: Quick check — finalizing owners/due dates for INC-482 postmortem items. I pulled the list from the doc, a few items missing owners. Can owners please ack and drop dates? cc @Priya @Miguel

Priya: Taking 'DB schema rollback plan' — can do by Fri 2026-04-23 EOD. Will coordinate with infra. @Anna can you be backup?

Anna: Yep I can be backup for rollback plan. Also owning 'canary test harness' — target Tue 2026-04-20 AM. I'll link the PR once it's up.

Miguel: I'll own 'alerting thresholds: token-queue growth' — need SRE to validate metrics query. Proposed due Mon 2026-04-19. tagging the oncall separately.

Samir: Great. Two items left: 'postmortem writeup edits' and 'customer notification template'. Any volunteers?

Priya: I can do the writeup edits — will do an initial pass by Sun 2026-04-18. For the customer template, support asked for a draft from product.

Miguel: Support wants phrasing that avoids technical detail. We need product signoff though. Anna, can you surface a short POC for product to review?

Anna: Yep — I'll draft the template and do a review on Mon 2026-04-19 afternoon. If product needs to sign-off I'll loop in Jae from PM and bring it back here.

deploy-bot: postmortem-bot: Postmortem doc updated: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/INC-482 — latest action list attached. Automated snapshot saved.

Samir: Thanks all. I'll update the tracker now with owners/dates in this format for visibility:
```
Owner | Item | Due
Priya | DB schema rollback plan | 2026-04-23
Anna  | Canary test harness | 2026-04-20
Miguel | Alerting thresholds (token queue) | 2026-04-19
Priya | Postmortem writeup edits | 2026-04-18
Anna  | Customer notification (review) | 2026-04-19
```
If anyone needs to swap ownership or update due dates, pls reply here or ping me directly. :thumbsup:
